Messages.Author: Eduardo Simões
Messages.Body: The Summoning at superior could be played 2,3 or 4 times by a same vampire? And Summon History works too???

Messages.Author: Ke.
Messages.Body:
The Summoning is subject to the "No Repeat Action" rule as is Summon History. Both are once per turn per minion.

Messages.Author: Snodig
Messages.Body: You can, however, bring the same ally into play via The Summoning, Summon History, and the ally card itself - all in the same turn.

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
> Snodig wrote:
> You can, however, bring the same ally into play via The Summoning, Summon History, and the ally card itself - all in the same turn.
>
Assuming the ally isn't unique, or dies in between.

Reminder: Summon history is not a recruit action (unlike summoning), so the ally can act immediately upon arrival.

Reminder 2: No repeat actions rule is invoked when an action reaches resolution (usually this means being succesfully blocked or resolves succesfully). If an action is canceled by a card before action resolution, you can repeat that action with the same minion.
